Function for monitoring DragContinue signals. This function receives the signal's world space cursor ray and it returns a CFrame containing the desired location and orientation of the pivot in world space.

CSGDictionaryService is an internal service that stores a cache of BinaryStringValue objects, each value representing a unique data set for solid modeling data.
A version of the CSGDictionaryService that does not replicate to clients.

Options table for the method: - tolerance – The distance tolerance, in regards to Attachment preservation, between the attachment and the closest point on the original part's surface versus the closest point on the resulting part's surface. If the resulting distance following the solid modeling operation is greater than this value, the Parent of attachments and their associated constraints will be nil in the returned recommendation table. - weldConstraintPreserve – A WeldConstraintPreserve enum value describing how WeldConstraints are preserved in the resulting recommendation table.
